about_the_game:
Crowbar Heaven and Pendulum Slope, and both are available to play NOW!

■ What’s New in the Mega Stage Update:Two Exciting New Stages!!

◾️New Paid Stage: Crowbar Heaven!!



Welcome to Crowbar Heaven! All the fallen Crowbar Boys have now become angels! But beware! These “angels” are mischievous and will mess with you, hoping to add you to their ranks!

This heaven isn’t all milk and honey… many railings are cursed, and hooking your crowbar to them will send you falling straight down!

Please note: The Steam version does not include the "Angel Skin", and is priced accordingly lower.

Content differs from the Meta Horizon Store version.

◾️New Free Stage: Pendulum Slope!!



Welcome to Pendulum Slope: a compact battleground packed with swinging pendulums! With so many moving obstacles in a tight space, there are countless ways to climb… and just as many ways to fall! Precision and timing are key if you want to reach the top!

Climb your way to the summit and show those angels who’s boss!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1080/AMD Radeon RX 5700XT series or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR - Meta Quest Touch Controller, Valve Index Compatible
  • Additional Notes: If you are using a controller other than Meta Quest Touch, go to SteamVR settings and turn on OpenXR -> Meta Plugin Compatibility.
